create_tracker_results: create a TrackerResults dataclass to hold TAPNext point track trajectories, logits, and visibility predictions
run_tapnext_tracker_forward: run TAPNextTracker forward pass on a video with query points to estimate point tracks and visibility
run_tapnext_tracker_online: run TAPNextTracker forward_step for online per-frame tracking with cached hidden state
build_prediction_heads: build prediction heads that compute soft-argmax tracks, track logits, and visibility logits from query point features
configure_tapnext_tracker_heads: configure TAPNextTracker with linear or MLP prediction heads for coordinate and visibility output
